p.espaces.rg_d: Customs regulations, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: the official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens the current official resources, then you will read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): information on customs duties, taxes, rules and procedures for individual products and countries on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): tariffs and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and hygiene rules set for products in a given country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Country by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if the platform has been marked by the regulator before you entrust your money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: The page will open in your own language: use the translator of your browser, or « Understand the document » for the document.When making an important decision, ask an expert in the country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (shipper) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Bill of Lading (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificates, licenses, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer processes everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods with export clearance to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the goods on the ship; then the buyer bears the risks and costs.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays the cost and insurance to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers the goods to the destination, the buyer pays the import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicinal products. Such lists are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the charges for your country before shipping.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Money transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees are displayed before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Check the total amount you received: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often, an ID is required for both sending and collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online or to “unlock” a prize, package, loan or visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find suppliers, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find your supplier("Wholesale/Supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find out the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment and return fees.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from non-EU countries is subject to VAT from the first euro.
